About

“Learning the inner self through Children’s Theatre in order to unlearn the chaos.”

Annu Priya

Annu Priya was born in Samastipur, Bihar, and lives in New Delhi. She trained in acting at the National School of Drama, held the NSD Fellowship in 2023–24, and is a CCRT Junior Fellow for 2025–26.

Her work moves between stage and screen and between languages. She performs in Hindi, English, Bhojpuri, Maithili, Magahi, Angika and Bajjika, and sings in the Hindustani classical tradition.
